note: Legal name claimed as 'SANJAYKUMAR AMRUTLAL PATEL' — this is a person's name, not a company name; no CIN/PAN/GSTIN was found in public sources, so the legal-entity link between that individual and RUTU CHEMICALS is unverified (null). Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is contradicted by the shipment record: the goods are pharmaceutical allopathic raw material / bulk chemicals (Diclofenac Sodium, Cysteamine HCl, 2,6-Dichlorophenol, tert-Butyl chloroacetate) — the company is a chemicals/pharma-intermediates trader-manufacturer, not FMCG. Role appears to be trader/processor (imports Chinese intermediates, re-exports finished API to Turkey), i.e. manufacturer_trader or trader — not rejected on that basis per project rules. Export side is genuinely confirmed by one dated customs/B-L record; domestic India-side supply is unverified due to tool failures, not disproven.
